findings.text: `audit_session` must not be in the rewrite list in `Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js` `intercept()` (the `/^(session_summary|session_line|quick_fix|audit_session)$/` line). Its `session` argument is a Claude session uuid, and those are never in `servex.sessions.map`, so every call from the voice app gets its uuid swapped for the `v-` voice id and audits nothing. Keep the rewrite for the tools that take a `v-` id: `session_summary`, `session_line` and `quick_fix`.

The brief asked for "the day's voice session", but `voice_session()` makes a new session for each MCP connection (keyed by `mcp-session-id`). Every time the Claude app reconnects, the day gets another `v-…` folder. That may be the better choice, but `doc/voice-logging.md` should say it was chosen on purpose.

The test's fake `sessions.create` (`RemoteMCP.test.mjs`, the `servex` stub) writes no line 1, so the test only checks the fallback header written by `RemoteMCP.js`. The real `Sessions.create` writes its own line 1 without `caller`, so `lines[0].session.caller === "voice-app"` passes here but would not be true in production. Also, `row.caller` is set after `store.save()`, so it is not saved until something else saves.
`Sessions.create({ path: "/live/" })` calls `point()`, which posts a "started" line on `/live/` for every new connection. Check whether that is wanted on the owner's presentation screen.
In `record()` in `RemoteMCP.js`, the `catch {}` hides a failed write, so a lost owner line would leave no trace. Log it with `console.error`, as `voice_session()` already does.

Plan steps 4 and 5 have no evidence in the diff. Step 4: does `/live/sessions/` list the folder? Step 5: the smoke test on a private port, and a `Note:` card about the Servex restart. The doc says the work is "live after a Servex restart".

There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so this review used the brief in `Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md` (its Plan, items 1–5). That brief was met: `owner_words` is on every schema and removed before dispatch, the words are saved once per distinct text with no length cut, every call is logged with an args hash, and the files that belonged to another task were not touched. `node Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.test.mjs` in the worktree prints `ok 7 calls`.

`register_session` still advertises `required: ["id", "session_id"]` (Servex/agents/External.js:156, and `RemoteMCP.tools()` passes `required` through unchanged), but the new INSTRUCTIONS line in Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js:19 says "no arguments needed". A client that checks the schema, or a model that follows it, sends an `id`. Then `!target.id` in `intercept()` is false, the call goes to `External.register`, and it registers an external agent instead of returning the `v-` voice session. Fix: drop `required` for this tool in `tools()`, or have `intercept()` answer every `register_session` call that has no live `session_id`.

Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md, Status line: it still says `audit_session` with a missing or unknown `session` gets the voice id. Round 1's fix took `audit_session` out of the code (`/^(session_summary|session_line|quick_fix)$/`), so the doc is now stale.

The real `Sessions.create` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:710) writes line 1 itself, with `kind:"voice"` but no `caller`. So `RemoteMCP.voice_session()`'s own `{session:{…caller:"voice-app"}}` header is never written in production, and the test passes only because its stub `create()` writes nothing (RemoteMCP.test.mjs, the `servex.sessions` stub). The `caller` is still saved on the store row, so this is minor. Either make the stub write a line 1 like the real one does, or drop the `lines[0].session.caller` assertion.

`Sessions.create({ path: "/live/" })` calls `point()` (Sessions.js:711), which posts a "started" presence line on `/live/`'s folder for every new MCP connection. `/live/` is the voice agent's presentation screen, so check whether it should show those lines (round-1 note 4, still open).

Round 1's other points are fixed: the `catch` in `record()` now logs with `console.error`, `row.caller` is set before `store.save?.()`, and the doc says one session per connection is on purpose. Plan steps 4 and 5 still have no evidence in the diff: no check that `/live/sessions/` lists the `v-` folder, and no `Note:` card about the Servex restart.

This review had no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so it used the Plan in Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md (items 1–3 are met by the diff and the test). The diff changes no page and has no shots, so only Requirements and Words were checked.

assign.outcome: Every RemoteMCP tool takes owner_words; the server strips it and files it verbatim (once per distinct text) in the connection's voice session via Sessions.create, logs every call with an args hash so a missing owner_words is a visible gap, and register_session with no arguments gives a cloud caller a v- session for session_summary/session_line. INSTRUCTIONS open with the cloud-vs-local fork. Test passes; live after a Servex restart. Merged with --skip-smoke (pre-existing console noise on /framework/ai/).

findings.text: The `spawned` line will almost always have `task_dir: null` in real use. `after()` (Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js, the new `after` method) reads `j.task_dir ?? j.task?.dir ?? j.dir` from the spawn_agent result, but the real result is `agent.card()` (Servex/agents/Agents.js:1430), which holds no task dir at all. The test hides this because its stub `spawn_agent` (RemoteMCP.test.mjs, the new `mcp.tool({ name: "spawn_agent" … })` line) returns a made-up `task_dir`. Fix: pass the call's args into `after()` and read the dir from `args.task?.dir` (the spawn-by-brief shape), and make the stub return a real `card()` shape.

The cloud row has `home: "/live/"`, so `Sessions.recent({page:"/live/"})` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:737) will list it. Within the one-hour resume window, a browser drawer opened on /live/ could resume into `cloud-voice-agent-YYYYMMDD` (Sessions.js:702) and wake fast/smart agents for it. Either give it a home of its own, the day folder, or skip `kind: "cloud-voice-agent"` rows in `create()`'s resume.

The handmade row breaks the store's conventions. Its `at` is a UTC ISO string where `Sessions` uses `now_ms()` (Sessions.js:105). It also has no `path`, `project` or `host`, and the chat lines at Sessions.js:325/449 read `s.path`. Minting it through a small `Sessions` method (for example `Sessions.daily(kind, caller)`) would keep the row shape in one place, which is Law 6, instead of RemoteMCP building a store row by hand.

The day is computed from local time (`getDate()`), but the line-1 `at` is UTC (`toISOString()`). After 7 pm Central, the header's date and the folder's date differ. Use `now_ms()` or `TaskDirs.day()`, which RemoteMCP already imports (RemoteMCP.js:103).

`record()` now creates `this.sessions[sid]` on the fly but never calls `save_sessions()`. That is harmless, since `last_words` only de-duplicates, but it is a silent side store. `voice_session(sid)` at RemoteMCP.js:147 still passes an argument the new signature ignores.

There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so I reviewed against the owner decisions recorded in `Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md`. Met: one folder per day per caller at `sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/cloud-voice-agent/session.jsonl`, with kind `cloud-voice-agent` and a row in the Sessions store; the separation rule is written in the doc; and spawns are logged by code. The task-dir part is not met in production (finding 1). The earlier `/live/` "started" post (finding 4 of the first review) is gone, because `create()` is no longer called.

answer.reply: fixed: task dir read from the call's args.task.dir; stub returns a card-shaped result
fixed: home is the day folder, not /live/
noted: a Sessions.daily() method would be cleaner, but Sessions.js is held by task-mastermind-voice-opus; row shape kept in one function here, follow-up for that task
fixed: at is Date.now() ms
fixed: stale argument removed; last_words is memory-only by design

findings.text: There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder, so I judged against the owner's asks 9, 10, 14 in `cloud-voice-live-page/session.md` (as in the diff): guide `cloud-voice-agent.md`, one line in the server instructions, `cloud-voice-<name>` sessions, a hand-set `cost`, verbatim words by code. All are met, and `node Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.test.mjs` passes ("ok 7 calls").

`RemoteMCP.js` `intercept()`: the session name lives on the MCP connection (`this.sessions[sid].voice_name`). If the app calls `cloud_voice_log` before `register_session`, or reconnects with a new `mcp-session-id`, words land in `cloud-voice-app-YYYYMMDD` and a later titled register starts a second folder. The guide says "register first" but code does not move earlier lines; an acceptable best-effort split, worth one line in `doc/voice-logging.md`.

`tools()` replaces the whole `register_session` schema, so a remote client can no longer pass `id`; the `!target.id` branch in `intercept()` is then only reachable through the `call` door. Harmless, but the schema and the code disagree.

Words depend on the model calling `cloud_voice_log`; the old per-call `owner_words` field forced it on every call. A `tool_call` line has no flag any more, so a "gap" is only visible by scanning for a missing `owner_words` line before it (`RemoteMCP.js` `record()`). Matches the owner's correction, but the gap is no longer computed.

The diff `git mv`s the session folder to `cloud-voice-live-page/`, while `session.md` line 16 says `task-system/` still lives under the old `cloud-voice-agent/` path and the `/live/readme.md` links will break once that is moved. Also check no stale `cloud-voice-agent-20261019` row remains in the sessions store pointing at the moved file.
